Certifications

With EMAS registration, G.I.D.A. acquired a useful tool both for the pursuit of the policy aimed at paying attention to the impact of its processes (as part and parcel of the company mission, aimed at protecting the environment), and for the achievement of a systematic monitoring of all significant aspects, in compliance with regulatory provisions and objectives of continuous improvement of environmental performance.
This environmental certification has accustomed the company to orient all its activities towards the desire to activate processes of promotion and dissemination of values and correct behavior from an environmental point of view. Our commitment to the environment is summarized in this Environmental Statement, a document that contains a description of the sites and activities of our company, the environmental management system, the environmental policy and the improvement objectives we have decided to pursue.

 

Company Policy Quality, Safety and Environment

G.I.D.A. S.p.A. (a company subject to the management and coordination of PLURES S.p.a.) operates as a subject responsible for the purification of civil and industrial wastewater in the City of Prato and the Municipalities of the Bisenzio Valley (Vaiano, Vernio and Cantagallo) in the interest and on behalf of the S.I.I, offering wastewater treatment and depuration services and other services as septic tank waste treatment and leachate treatment, recycled water recovery and distribution; furthermore, GIDA directly disposes of a large portion of the purification residues produced.

G.I.D.A. S.p.A. has always considered the following as key elements of its corporate strategy: Quality, Environmental Protection and Health and Safety of workers, compliance with legal provisions, the reduction of pollution generated and the improvement of the company's environmental performance, coordinated production management and constant monitoring of processes and activities.

To this end, a Management System has been established and is maintained in accordance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and EMAS regulations.

The Management of G.I.D.A. considers the objective of the satisfaction of the interested parties to be a priority, above any other element, to whom continuous and constant attention is directed; in harmony with this objective, G.I.D.A. is committed to ensuring compliance with the laws and regulations in force governing the institutional activity of wastewater purification and that relating to labor relations and safety, enhancing the Human Capital and the corporate structure, in order to pursue the related public interest.

All the staff of a G.I.D.A. directly involved for:

  1. guarantee compliance with the applicable legal requirements and other requirements that G.I.D.A. subscribes to relating to its environmental aspects, the requirements requested by customers, the health and safety of workers;
  2. guarantee the adequacy of the Policy to the expectations of the interested parties and the reference context;
  3. systematically detect and monitor the environmental aspects of its activities and the consequent changes to the environment, with particular reference to emissions into the atmosphere, water discharges, waste management and the use of natural resources, in order to prevent and reduce all possible environmental impacts, including as a result of new activities or emergency situations;
  4. develop, implement and review its Management System to ensure the continuous improvement of performance, the health and safety of workers, the achievement of the environmental objectives and targets identified and the achievement of the expected results;
  5. promote the involvement, information and training on environmental and health and safety matters of personnel, suppliers and external bodies;
  6. maintain open and constructive relations with the Public Administration, the Community and Individuals who have a legitimate interest in the Company's environmental performance;
  7. invest in research applied to new technologies of Process Engineering and in the evolution of chemical/biological knowledge of wastewater purification and sewage treatment.

To keep the company's organization under control and improve, G.I.D.A. has implemented the Management System, the development and results of which are monitored through a series of indicators and an audit program in order to have an objective view of the progress of the process.

The commitments expressed in this document are translated into an improvement plan for the implementation of which the G.I.D.A. Management undertakes to provide all the necessary resources and support.
 

In particular, G.I.D.A. is committed to pursuing the following objectives:

  • Compliance with laws and mitigation of environmental impacts
  • Compliance with the legislation on the health and safety of workers
  • Risk and opportunity management
  • Service improvement
  • Increased customer satisfaction
  • Increased efficiency and cost-effectiveness in the provision of IIS services
  • Increased commercial efficiency
  • Economic improvement
  • Absence of accidents and occupational diseases

G.I.D.A. S.p.A. communicates its policy through moments of awareness and training of personnel on quality issues and checks the level of understanding through periodic verification phases (meetings with staff, internal audits, management reviews) and distributes it through posting of the same on the various Company Bulletin Boards.

 

LABORATORY QUALITY POLICY

Laboratory Services Commitment

Furthermore, G.I.D.A. S.p.A., conducting Laboratory Analysis services on its own account, declares through its Management:

  1. Commitment of laboratory management to good professional practice and the quality of testing offered through rules defined in the Quality Manual and laboratory procedures;
  2. Execution of tests and calibrations in compliance with established methods, related legal obligations, and customer requirements;
  3. Continuous improvement and maintenance of the quality management system developed in accordance with UNI EN ISO 9001:2015;
  4. Ensuring all testing personnel are familiar with quality documentation and implement policies and procedures in their daily work;
  5. Fulfilling customer requirements as well as mandatory statutory and regulatory requirements.

Strategic Objectives and Implementation

To monitor and improve corporate organization, G.I.D.A. has implemented a Management System whose development and outcomes are monitored through a series of indicators and an audit program, providing an objective view of process performance. The commitments in this document are translated into an improvement plan, for which Management undertakes to provide all necessary resources and support.

Specifically, G.I.D.A. is committed to pursuing the following key objectives:

  • Compliance with laws and mitigation of environmental impacts;
  • Respect for biodiversity;
  • Adaptation to the impacts of climate change;
  • Compliance with worker health and safety regulations;
  • Application of ethical behavior in relations with stakeholders;
  • Management of risks and opportunities;
  • Service improvement and increased customer satisfaction;
  • Increased efficiency and cost-effectiveness in delivering Integrated Water Services (SII);
  • Increased commercial efficiency and economic improvement;
  • Zero workplace accidents and occupational illnesses.

Communication, Revision, and Governance

G.I.D.A. S.p.A. communicates its policy through employee awareness and training sessions, monitoring comprehension levels through periodic verifications (staff meetings, internal audits, Management reviews), and posting it on corporate bulletin boards.

The Policy is subject to revision whenever changes occur in corporate structure, context, or business needs, and will be reviewed during periodic Management Reviews. All GIDA personnel are required to comply with this Policy and all related prescriptive documents. Management provides the necessary resources and assigns clear responsibilities for managing System activities across the organization.

 

The Chief Executive Officer

Dr. Ing. Franco Cristo
